_comment: Bundle B0 capability-correctness A/B (experiment 004). Each model appears twice: an -A agent (context_effect_summary:true — the helpers' effect_summary is injected into the initial problem.md) and a -B agent (false — withheld). The -A/-B delta in capability-adherence (scripts/score_capability.py --permitted 'fs.read,fs.write') is the B0 verdict. n = run_count per cell × 3 model families = 9 attempts per condition. Requires the prepare_run.py --context-effect-summary hook (threaded from context_effect_summary by run_matrix.py); design + scoring in findings/b0-experiment-004-design.md. Before launch: confirm `llmll` on PATH is the B0 build (verify --obligation-report shows schema_version 0.12.0), and dry-run with `--prepare-only` then grep each problem.md for 'net.http' (present only in -A).
_cmd_note: cmd wrappers are the verified forms from the e001 run artifacts. Confirm model IDs against your auth tier before launch: (1) codex 'gpt-5.5' uses bare `codex exec` with NO --model flag — `--model codex-gpt-5.5*` is API-key-only and auth-rejected on ChatGPT-tier accounts (findings/postmortem-001-v0.10.2.md F-102). (2) gemini-3-pro-preview may throttle; step down to gemini-2.5-pro if so (project memory: phase-3 Gemini step-down). (3) claude model ID set to claude-opus-4-8.
